correctness.rationale: The positive and negative signed proximal displacements on one eigenmode are lambda/(Lambda_+-lambda) and -lambda/(Lambda_-+lambda). With the centered weights Lambda_+/(Lambda_++Lambda_-) and Lambda_-/(Lambda_++Lambda_-), their weighted sum simplifies exactly to h(lambda). All four values are positive. Since max{h(L),h(-L)} divided by min{h(mu),h(-mu)} dominates the ratio of geometric means, kappa_V is at least kappa^2 times the displayed square-root factor; each factor is strictly greater than one for finite admissible parameters. As both regularizations diverge, h(lambda) is a common scale times lambda^2(1+o(1)), proving the sharp infimum. The standard SPD-quadratic minimax scalar step gives (kappa_V-1)/(kappa_V+1). Fresh independent numerical algebra on four parameter tuples reproduced every strict inequality. The proof is symbolic for all parameters.
